resources.string: I don’t have a recovery code
A recovery code has 24 characters (digits and letters).
Wrong recovery code. Wait %1$ds before retrying.
No recovery code was created on this device.

Without the PIN or the recovery code, the tracker data on this device cannot be decrypted, not even by the BHODL developers. You can erase the local data and start again.

Kept: your bitcoin, and your wallets: add them again from their xpub, and balances and history come back from the blockchain.

Lost: categories, rules, budgets, investments and lots, sales, manual assets, liabilities, goals, labels, contacts and custom cost-basis prices.
If you forget your device PIN, this code is the only way to open your tracker data again. It is shown once and never stored: write it down or keep it in a password manager, away from this computer.
A recovery code already exists. A new one replaces it, and the current code stops working.
Losing both the PIN and this code means losing the tracker data on this device.
To confirm you saved it, type group %1$d of the code:
Recovery code saved. You can create a new one from the Security Hub at any time.
Could not create the recovery code: %1$s
Created: the way back in if you forget the device PIN.
Not created: forgetting the device PIN would mean losing the tracker data.
Available once the device PIN exists.
